name: Davivienda
body: robots.txt lets AI answer bots like OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot in while blocking the training bots GPTBot, CCBot, and Google-Extended. But real Chrome visitors wait 4.6 s for the largest content.
lesson: Find the Largest Contentful Paint element on your home page and serve it first: preload, size, compress.
summary: www.davivienda.com scores 72 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 1 page has no title.

fix.title: 1 page has no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on 19 of 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: ivad, ivab. Set on /wps/portal/empresas/nuevo.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 4.6 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 260 ms (needs improvement), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.08 (good). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Break up long JavaScript tasks behind clicks and taps, and defer…

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
